title: FACE-DEC
description: This dataset contains OPM-MEG recordings from a face processing study conducted at the whole-brain and sensor level. The data were originally acquired using an in-house LabVIEW acquisition system and later converted to FIF format for standardized analysis. Analyses include preprocessing, decoding, representational similarity analysis (RSA), statistical testing, and Bayesian model selection.
methods_description: Data were acquired using OPM-MEG hardware, originally stored in an in-house LabVIEW format and later converted to FIF format. Sensor coordinates were approximated using positions from the Elekta layout for topographic visualization purposes only, as individual facial point clouds and structural MRIs were not collected.
